name: pi-claude-hooks
description: Runs Claude Code-style settings.json hooks under the pi coding agent. Bridges Pi lifecycle events to the Claude hook contract (PreToolUse/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop), synthesizing the Claude-shaped stdin JSON and honoring exit-code-2 / permissionDecision:deny / decision:block to BLOCK a tool call. Gives Pi behavior parity with Claude Code for any project that registers hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json (e.g. Planet Argon's guard scripts).
